channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Sep 21
item.description:
86 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Adjusted collider sizes for critter animals, affecting hit detection and interaction with small wildlife.

Weapons

  • Fixed fractional reloads for the mini crossbow, restoring proper reload behavior.

Vehicles & Transport

  • Introduced a new ridable horse prefab, adding horses as drivable mounts.
  • Fixed boat power‑down mechanic when lowering sails and quickly jumping off, stopping the boat from drifting away on its own.
  • Added a 15‑minute delay to the oil pump mechanic; rig timer now runs 20 minutes plus a configurable start‑delay.
  • Repaired broken helipad stage setup, restoring proper helipad functionality.

World Building & Deployables

  • External gate upgrades now correctly preserve door controller settings, fixing broken functionality after upgrades.
  • Fixed deployables being hidden when exterior doors close, preventing clipping through doors.
  • Added configurable tolerance for deployables on deformed terrain and ensured foundations always place against the original terrain height, preventing placement over deep carves.

Hunting & Animals

  • Added a sheep trophy head to the hunting trophy prefab and corrected a ragdoll bug where male calf models appeared on female ragdolls.
  • Adjusted collider sizes for critter animals, affecting hit detection and interaction with small wildlife.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Implemented new UI for the biofuel generator with a progress bar for stirring and other minor mount/dismount tweaks.
  • Fixed computer station identifier input box text being hidden at certain resolutions.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Sep 20
item.description:
17 development commits

Base Building

  • Building is now blocked within a radius of sandbag pillboxes, preventing structures from being placed directly on or too close to them.

Livestock & Animals

  • Sheep automatically unlead when mounted and re‑lead after dismount, with updated mount/dismount animations.

Item Durability

  • Condition (durability) has been disabled for diving masks, crate & barrel costumes, prisoner hoods, sunglasses, geiger counters, metal detectors, RF pagers, and mobile phones, so these items no longer degrade.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Sep 19
item.description:
16 development commits

Livestock & Animal Behavior

  • Leading livestock now works reliably and shows a visible rope.
  • Livestock headbutt damage increased; bulls no longer attack in safe zones; leading bulls stop fighting others; grazing through walls fixed; stop‑leading prompt bug fixed.
  • Livestock avoidance speed doubled, making them steer away from obstacles faster.
  • Bulls no longer attempt headbutts on unreachable players.
  • Animals no longer get stuck circling obstacles when fleeing or charging.

UI & Store

  • Store no longer shows a 'content failed to load' error when your inventory is empty.
